chaining: An IPv6-only box with root and 65,536 addresses per VM composes with a free IPv4-to-IPv6 front (Cloudflare Workers or a free tunnel) to become a reachable origin, and with an ssh cron job on a second free host to automate the renewal click.

limits.value: server duration must be extended by renewal; the default term is not published

limits_note: Each VPS is provisioned for 7 days and a renewal extends it no more than a week past the renewal day, so an always-on server needs a manual renewal about weekly; the vendor wording at least 3 days before it expires is read by third-party users as a window that opens in the last 3 days, and expired servers are deleted daily at 17:00 UTC with no backup.
binding_note: the server expires and must be renewed, and the term is not published, so it cannot be planned around.

identity_cost.detail: unverified. The create form asks for a data centre, an operating system, a password, a purpose and four agreement checkboxes; it has no email field. The site's operations (create, renew, status) run through a Telegram identity, and no page read states the exact gate. A phone-linked Telegram account is the likely requirement, and it is not proved here.
